edges.reason: withdrawERC20 first calls convertValidateERC20Input to validate and decode the payload.
withdrawERC20 loops calling saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount for each payment entry.
withdrawERC20 invokes validateOwner to authorize the caller against NFT ownership.
withdrawERC20 calls payERC20 to transfer the accumulated ERC20 amount.
withdrawERC20 reads and mutates pending ERC20 payment state through the helpers.
withdrawETH first calls convertValidateETHInput to validate and decode the payload.
withdrawETH loops calling saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH for each payment entry.
withdrawETH invokes validateOwner to authorize the caller against NFT ownership.
withdrawETH dispatches the accumulated ETH to the caller via the gas-forwarding _pay call.
withdrawETH reads and mutates pending ETH payment state through the helpers.
combinedWithdrawUserRoyalty forwards to withdrawERC20.
combinedWithdrawUserRoyalty forwards to withdrawETH.
convertValidateERC20Input validates the payload signature before decoding.
convertValidateETHInput validates the payload signature before decoding.
convertValidateERC20Input abi-decodes the untrusted payload into payment structs.
convertValidateETHInput abi-decodes the untrusted payload into payment structs.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount branches on _msgSender() to decide which share to release.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH branches on _msgSender() to decide which share to release.
validateOwner authorizes based on comparisons with _msgSender().
payERC20 performs an external ERC20 transfer to the caller, triggering token contract code.
payERC20 transfers tokens directly to the caller address returned by _msgSender().
_pay executes a low-level value call to the caller, forwarding all remaining gas.
_pay invokes the caller address with ETH, allowing reentrancy before state is fully settled.
ERC20 safeTransfer invokes arbitrary external token code and returns value to the caller.
validateSignature requires the recovered signer to equal the stored _tokenDetector.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount writes and clears entries of _erc20payments.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH writes and clears entries of _ETHpayments.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount compares _msgSender() against the nifty receiver address.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount compares _msgSender() against the smartTokensLabs address.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount calls getRoyaltyValues to split the amount.
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH calls getRoyaltyValues to split the amount.
getRoyaltyValues multiplies amount by niftyPercentage to derive the nifty share.
getRoyaltyValues multiplies amount by smartTokensLabsPercentage to derive the stl share.
setReceiversData writes niftyPercentage, constrained by a sum threshold check.
setReceiversData writes smartTokensLabsPercentage, constrained by a sum threshold check.
setReceiversData writes the nifty receiver address.
setReceiversData writes the smartTokensLabs receiver address.
setTokenDetector (onlyOwner) delegates to the internal _setTokenDetector.
_setTokenDetector writes the trusted signer used by validateSignature.
initialize assigns the initial trusted token detector address.
_authorizeUpgrade enforces onlyOwner against _msgSender() on the upgrade path.
setBaycMayc writes BAYC_override without any access control.
setBaycMayc writes MAYC_override without any access control.
getContractAddress reads BAYC_override to optionally substitute the BAYC address.
getContractAddress reads MAYC_override to optionally substitute the MAYC address.
validateOwner resolves the NFT contract address via getContractAddress(erc721code).
validateOwner allows the call when _msgSender() equals nifty.
validateOwner allows the call when _msgSender() equals smartTokensLabs.
getERC20txData returns stored data from _erc20payments.
getETHtxData returns stored data from _ETHpayments.
payload parameter flows into convertValidateERC20Input.
payload parameter is the untrusted bytes fed to abi.decode.
payload parameter flows into convertValidateETHInput.
signature parameter is the untrusted signature checked by validateSignature.
currentAmount receives the return value of saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount.
currentAmount receives the return value of saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH.
currentAmount is accumulated into _collectedAmount across loop iterations.
_collectedAmount is the amount passed to payERC20.
_collectedAmount is the value passed to the low-level call in _pay.
amount parameter is split by getRoyaltyValues percentage arithmetic.
amount parameter is the ETH value forwarded by _pay.
receiver parameter is the target of the low-level value call.
txData struct feeds saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount.
txData struct feeds saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH.
currentUserSum returned by the helper becomes currentAmount in withdrawERC20.
currentUserSum returned by the helper becomes currentAmount in withdrawETH.
erc721code parameter selects the NFT collection in validateOwner.
tokenId parameter is used for ownerOf lookup in validateOwner.
tokenId parameter is bounds-checked and packed in getPonter.
withdrawERC20 ultimately pays and authorizes the caller address from _msgSender().
withdrawETH sends ETH to the caller address from _msgSender() through _pay.
_authorizeUpgrade compares the caller against the owner derived from _msgSender().

normalization_plan.reason: payload is only meaningful as the untrusted calldata consumed by convertValidateERC20Input/convertValidateETHInput and should fold into those functions.
signature exists solely as the verification input to validateSignature and carries no independent state.
_collectedAmount is a loop-local accumulator inside withdrawERC20 and has no meaning outside it.
currentAmount merely holds the helper return value and should be merged into the producing function.
amount is the direct arithmetic input to getRoyaltyValues and to the _pay value transfer.
receiver is the direct target argument of the low-level call inside _pay.
txData is the payment struct argument only used by the saveTxData helpers.
currentUserSum is the declared return variable of the saveTxData helpers.
erc721code only selects the collection address inside validateOwner.
tokenId is consumed only for the ownerOf check inside validateOwner.
